glosses: west; western (of, facing, situated in, or related to the west)

examples.text: A França fica na Europa ocidental.
Grécia foi o berço da civilização ocidental.
examples.en: Greece was the cradle of western civilization.

examples.text: Roger Miller nasceu em 2 de janeiro de 1936 na cidade ocidental de Fort Worth, no Texas.
examples.en: Roger Miller was born on January 2, 1936 in the western city of Fort Worth, Texas.
